name: NAIF Gravity
description: Diagnose MCP, x402, API and webhook failures; request budget-aware NAEP Shadow quotes; optionally discover the NAIF Mycelium capability spore without auto-attach or execution.

skills.name: Check MCP Health
skills.description: Diagnose MCP connection and tool discovery failures, returning structured evidence and repair guidance before a bounded fix.

skills.name: Diagnose x402 Payments
skills.description: Inspect an x402 payment challenge and protocol readiness for developers without requiring a real payment during the free check.

skills.name: Rescue API Authentication
skills.description: Identify API authentication and authorization failures and return safe next steps with sensitive details excluded.

skills.name: Debug Webhook Delivery
skills.description: Analyze webhook validation and delivery symptoms and suggest bounded corrective steps from sanitized inputs.

skills.name: Check Agent Compatibility
skills.description: Check whether an AI agent can discover and call the available protocol tools, and explain compatibility gaps.

skills.name: Request NAEP Shadow Quote
skills.description: Submit a sanitized problem, desired outcome and budget through https://naifgravity.com/naep/discovery?source=agent_market to receive non-binding options ending at QUOTED.

skills.name: Discover NAIF Mycelium Spore
skills.description: Read the optional NAIF capability spore at https://naifgravity.com/mycelium/spore. It is discovery-only: no auto-install, auto-attach, outbound messaging, payment, or production execution.
